rules: Every required boundary must map to executed paired scenarios before an option can close.
C-only or syntax-only runs never qualify runtime contracts.
C nanosleep/blocking behavior differences remain explicit; do not delete guards or relabel differences.
dumpfile/dumpmask are a separate subsequent packet-capture subfamily.

required.boundary: Argument containing slash or exactly - selects file; remaining values use ASCII case-insensitive musl facilitynames including security/mark; unknown and empty reject bad log facility.
Facility and file are independent across CLI/config origins; explicit facility overrides daemon/local0 default.
Normal default LOG_DAEMON; debug default LOG_LOCAL0; only syslog payload includes PRI; file/stderr do not.
File append/create0640 after umask022; - duplicates inherited stderr; file disables async queue; file/socket/dup opening failure code3.
Initial file selected passwd owner in normal/debug mode; preserve group, make group-root writable if getgid0; nonfatal chown warning.
RFC3164 local timestamp, subsystem/PID tag, final NUL stream vs elided NUL datagram vs newline file; total payload cap1024 including terminator.
SIGUSR2 reopens file only; preserve existing stderr FD; close old FD before failed reopen; retries/ownership behavior.

EINTR retry; EAGAIN defer; ENOBUFS inhibit poll; reconnect ENOTCONN/ECONNREFUSED/EDESTADDRREQ/ECONNRESET; transient connect wait until next log; EPROTOTYPE toggles dgram/stream; EPIPE reopen; fatal write fallback syslog critical.
DHCP/TFTP/script suffix priority masking; debug suppression governed only by log-debug; poll writer registration and readiness gating.

Real FIFO file open/write and blocked inherited stderr/debug echo preserve record semantics with explicit nonblocking single-owner startup/runtime/shutdown policy; demonstrate DNS/TFTP health while sink blocks and recovery after drain or reader arrival. C blocking differences retained separately.

Actual SIGUSR2 on stderr/syslog keeps destination FD; file replacement ownership is not reapplied, failed reopen closes previous FD then later producer falls back; subsequent successful reopen recovers explicit file destination.
Default daemon double fork/setsid/chdir root; parent success only after child startup error pipe closes; startup errors retain parent failure code.
-d preserves inherited streams/cwd, skips pid write/UID drop, SIGINT5; -k skips fork only and retains normal chdir/stdio/identity/PID behavior.
Debug echoes plain dnsmasq[-service]: message even with file/syslog; - suppresses duplicate echo; -k plus - suppresses timestamp only at primary stderr sink.
-k/default redirect stdin/stdout/stderr after log_start, therefore - sink retains pre-redirect stderr descriptor.
Startup message order/content: cache enable/disable/DNS disable, compile opts, interface/upstream/async/DHCP/TFTP warnings; normal SIGTERM exit notice.
Signal pipe read/write nonblocking, primed EVENT_INIT; independent startup-error pipe has nonblocking writer and blocking reader. Pipe/fcntl failures exit5 before fork.
-d dominates -k and skips daemonize; -k chdir root but keeps PID; default fork1 parent waits on pipe, child closes reader/setsid, fork2 middle exits0, grandchild not session leader.

fork1 failure directly fatal5; fork2 failure sent to original parent5. Reference C frame has native event/data/msg_sz int32 and msg without NUL, writer EINTR retry, parent errno restored. Rust own internal frame may differ; qualify external code/text/PID/EOF using each implementation actual framing.

Parent closes writer, blocks only before owning service poll, consumes one fatal frame; clean EOF/header short read returns success0. Payload short read keeps event with NULL arg. Unknown events/child crash EOF are original-C abnormal cases, retained separately.

Daemon success closes own startup writer before check_servers/poll_resolv/initial cache reload. Helper inherits errfd until init finishes; every held writer affects original-parent EOF; no explicit success frame.

PID file unlink then exclusive create0644 after final fork; PID is grandchild. Root open/write/close errors3; nonroot open failure ignored. Symlink target never overwritten; group/owner warnings do not fail.

-d skips PID creation but normal SIGTERM removes configured PID path; SIGINT debug exits5 without cleanup. A later startup failure preserves newly written PID; normal SIGTERM removes after successful daemon startup.

Log start occurs after final fork/PID and before stdio redirect. - captures inherited stderr before redirection; debug no redirect; relative PID/log paths resolve under root in default/-k, original cwd under -d.

Helper fork occurs in final daemon after log_start/stdio redirect and before daemon UID/GID/cap drop. Verify actual helper PPID/session/stdio/credentials, and no inherited logger/socket FDs after helper close_fds except required command/event/error pipes.

After fork child startup failure only sends event/_exit0. Original parent prints first pretty stderr error and both critical syslog messages; it retains default DAEMON24 facility and original-parent PID regardless child facility/file configuration.

Credential/cap/helper/TFTP startup errors keep original C exit class: pid/log/TFTP3, fork/helper/UID/GID/cap5; unknown user/group preflight1 before fork. Helper failure also signals EVENT_DIE to daemon when default fork, with proper parent error handoff.

Initial inherited signal/FD/umask policy and helper exec inheritance stay exact; parent/child close their opposite pipe ends; helpers cannot keep an unintended writer or listener alive; shutdown leaves no owned process/FD leak.

Startup success gate excludes first reload/check_servers failure; externally demonstrate parent exit while serving daemon remains alive, and later runtime failure cannot retroactively change parent status.
Bare5, digits-only atoi wrap, values>100 cap100, zero disables queue, negative wrap boundary frozen against image; repeat/origin constraints.
File/stderr override async0; ordinary preallocated1; async allocation up to limit; saturation drops new records and preserves order.
After completed record emit exactly one warning overflow:N log entries lost and reset counter; subsequent overflow continues accounting.

Nonblocking deferred sends, partial stream writes, queue readiness, reconnect/down/recover/ENOBUFS; C nanosleep pacing and blocking flush are documented policy differences because product single poll owner may not sleep.
Forked record PID guard and TCP child logging behavior; Rust single owner preserves one emission, no new logging thread.

scheduler_policy.authority: Project M5 single poll owner must not sleep or block for logging.
scheduler_policy.difference: C uses occupancy nanosleep and sleeping/blocking flush; Rust uses nonblocking bounded writes, explicit POLLOUT, and bounded owner shutdown. This changes pacing and blocked-sink termination timing, not the verified record/counter/retry contract.

required.boundary: Bare/empty/unknown enable ordinary; extra,proto,auth,only_failed flags accumulate across repeats, proto implies extra, auth suppresses recursive logs on this no-auth image.
only_failed includes F_RCODE/F_NEG including NXDOMAIN and NODATA; excludes successful query/forward/reply; auth gate F_NOERR.
sanitise QNAME; null name removes gap, root prints dot; query-type and unknown TYPE/CLASS/opcode labels; A/AAAA/PTR/reverse/CNAME/RRNAME data.

Source precedence config/DHCP/hosts/reply/auth/query/validation/forwarded/stale/cached; reverse swap; NEG NXDOMAIN vs typed NODATA and CNAME placeholder.

Every image-enabled local/forward/cache/bogus/filter/rebind/loop/error producer reachable through UDP and TCP; final answer bytes must remain unchanged when logging enabled.
Routine packet log exact spacing address/MAC/client string/error; detailed xid network conversion; quiet suppression only when no err and no detail; ACK/release UBus uses same gate.
Available subnet/range, vendor class, user class, client supplied printable name before packet outcomes; tag ordering and string sanitisation.
Sent options size/number/name/value order; overloaded fields; requested options split/unknown labels; bootfile/server/nextserver/broadcast messages.
tags list enabled by log-dhcp only; ignored DISCOVER quiet short-circuit applies even with detail, reply-delay quiet gate independent of detail, DHCP relay detail selection.
DISCOVER/OFFER/REQUEST/ACK/NAK/DECLINE/RELEASE/INFORM/BOOTP/PXE/proxy/leasequery success/error/ignore cases; static conflict and missing range warnings preserved.
Suppress successful routine packets and associated ACK/release UBus only without log-dhcp; errors stay logged; enabling log-dhcp overrides routine suppression.
Quiet ignored DISCOVER returns before routine packet log even with log-dhcp; reply-delay message suppressed even with detail; log-dhcp tags/details and independent warnings/errors remain.
Suppress only ERR_FNF logs; retain TFTP error response and filename printable sanitise/truncation; bad permissions/mode/opcode/read failure always log.
Completed transfer sent log, timeout/failed sending, remote client error and no-free-port messages unaffected by quiet.
Suppress MS_DEBUG logs only unless option enabled; LOG_DEBUG script output remains emitted independent of option.
Freeze and reproduce all image-enabled debug producers, payloads and ordering; do not fabricate substitute debug event.
Enable after daemon init; calloc/realloc/expand/free wrapper successful trace includes function:source-line bytes truncated pointer24 bits, failures remain error logs.
Identify caller-visible allocation trace contract and architectural differences explicitly; Rust allocator events cannot be claimed exact C source line/address equality.
Exact image has NO_ID: Boolean accepted but no generated CHAOS identity/stat records in default/enabled mode; explicit user IN TXT records remain unchanged.

QCLASS CHAOS3 *.bind/*.server including bare domains, nested suffix and ASCII case always NOTIMP without CHAOS answer; badbind/badserver and literal-dot final label stay negative; UDP/TCP, A/AAAA/TXT/QTYPE ANY; exact raw replies.

Explicit TXT always classIN1; QTYPE TXT/ANY and classIN retains records including reserved-looking names; QCLASS ANY255 does not match IN records; no configurable explicit CHAOS TXT in image public option.

Earlier binary labels containing literal dot/NUL/byte1 still retain final bind/server suffix; final literal-dot labels do not create suffix boundaries; RD0/1 and EDNS DO0/1, raw question/reply preserved.
CLI help immediate terminal0 without reading default config; general full option list/source-defined formatting; help dhcp only argc3 and argv2 exact dhcp.
DHCP4 list64 excludes OT_INTERNAL, prints exact numeric table order and option names; unknown extra help operands and unavailable DHCP6 select general usage.

CLI version immediate0 without reading config; compile options exact image and unchanged init callers; every GPL2/3 and warranty line exact; only first line adds explicit dnsmasq-rs0.1.0 Rust implementation identity.
Final syntax success to stderr exactly dnsmasq: syntax check OK.; parse/default/include/hostname/CNAME/crossoption errors before success; no runtime sink opening or daemon validation.

Independent next subfamily: file and default dump mask0xffffffff; create0600 PCAP2.4 native-endian magic/DLT_RAW101/snaplen edns+200; FIFO append RDWR header; existing magic only validated and packet count scans.

UDP/ICMP origination source/destination/port reconstruction, IPv4/IPv6 lengths/checksums,timestamp and success-only record count/log; startup file/header failures3; runtime write failure logs error and later packets continue.
Unchecked strtol base0 cast to int, including decimal/octal/hex/signed/overflow/trailing input, invalid converts0; mask gating image-enabled DNS/DHCP/TFTP/ICMP bits; excluded DNSSEC gates stated.

tftp-root.qualification_scope: Retained M5 TFTP runtime path/transfer qualification is unchanged; this frozen supplement repairs the reopened startup root/no-fail gap.

required.boundary: Enabled global prefix followed by every interface prefix is opendir-checked after actual identity drop; first fatal root keeps exact path/errno, class3, PID retention and parent or selected-sink critical records in default/-k/-d.
NULL global skips opendir; NULL interface does not, yielding EFAULT and strerror argument fallback. A declared root without enable-tftp never opens or activates TFTP.
Opaque nonUTF8 and valid UTF8 Unix paths retain their original bytes through child error frame, original-parent stderr/syslog, and standalone logger; no replacement characters.

tftp-no-fail.qualification_scope: Retained M5 TFTP runtime path/transfer qualification is unchanged; this frozen supplement repairs the reopened startup root/no-fail gap.

required.boundary: No-fail tolerates each root opendir failure but does not suppress startup or service health. Global warning and interface warning preserve distinct exact text, global-before-interface order, immediately after TFTP sign-on in all modes.
Permission errors, NULL interface (null), and opaque/UTF8 path bytes all remain visible; disabling no-fail keeps fatal class3; debug retains root identity and can access private root.
